retained_source_meanings.construct: Synthetic gene constructs for Fluc-Ec2, Fluc-Bpe, Fluc-La1, and Fluc-La2 were inserted into a pASK vector with a C-terminal LysC recognition site and hexahistidine tag (TRKAASLVPRGSGGHHHHHH)
retained_source_meanings.membrane: using a POPE/POPG phospholipid mixture to form the bilayer
retained_source_meanings.ionic_conditions: with 300 mM or 30 mM NaF, 15 mM Mops-NaOH pH 7, in the cis or trans chamber respectively, trans defined as electrical ground
retained_source_meanings.current_baseline: zero current is defined as the mean level of the fully closed channel
retained_source_meanings.conducting_unit: precludes a definitive conclusion that the observed single-channel currents are mediated by a single pore rather than two in parallel
retained_source_meanings.endpoint: ionic currents mediated by Fluc-Ec2 inserted into planar phospholipid bilayers
retained_source_meanings.intended_variable: their appearance is strictly dependent on reconstituting Fluc protein into the liposomes
